bundle.longDescription:
GreyWork puts external coding agents (connected over the Agent Client
Protocol) and local OpenAI-compatible models to work in one desktop workspace.
Sessions, artifacts, previews and multi-agent pipelines live side by side,
so an agent's output is something you open rather than something you copy out
of a terminal.
